gitCommit.subject: Public site: footer on one row at desktop width, Products card full width
gitCommit.body:
Public site: footer on one row at desktop width, Products card full width

The organization and the four link columns share one row from 900 px (auto-fit
dropped the Legal column onto a second row at 1280 px); the Products card spans
the column with its six capabilities in three columns.
